name: Grant Carroll
story: Grant Carroll's experience covers the ArcGIS product family, including desktop GIS, server systems and portals. His professional profile describes more than fifteen years working with these products and records study at the University of Otago from 2004 to 2007. He gained Esri's ArcGIS Developer Foundation certification in March 2022.
